0x800a6a14.name: send_mesg
0x800a6a14.reason: Handwritten exceptasm.s. send_mesg ends `jr s2; nop`; the next 52 bytes (handle_CpU) are entered only by `beq` from __osException and leave by branching back into it. No call, pointer or padding separates them, so binary evidence attaches them to the preceding code. The reference gives handle_CpU its own glabel, which is an authoring choice in hand-written asm, not a compiler-visible boundary.
